design_rules.source: Chinese radical semantics redrawn as ink-and-seal interface symbols
design_rules.non_goal: Do not render the glyphs as ordinary readable Chinese characters.

glyphs.label: 名
glyphs.visual_contract: A sealed mouth frame plus a small identity spark; should read as naming/recognition, not a normal Chinese 名.

glyphs.label: 门
glyphs.meaning: 连接空间、开启路径、建立通道。
glyphs.visual_contract: A threshold frame with a broken hinge mark; should read as passage/rule boundary.

glyphs.label: 火
glyphs.visual_contract: A central ink flame with two feeder sparks; should read as activation/energy, not a literal campfire icon.

glyphs.label: 止
glyphs.visual_contract: A grounded stop peg crossing a boundary line; should read as stabilization and pause.

glyphs.label: 约
glyphs.visual_contract: A knot enclosed by a rule bracket; should read as binding/permission.

glyphs.label: 史
glyphs.visual_contract: A scroll spine with index cuts; should read as archive/history.

glyphs.label: 星
glyphs.visual_contract: A star point over a measuring horizon; should read as observation/coordinate.

glyphs.label: 续
glyphs.visual_contract: Two linked page strokes with a continuation thread; should read as continuation/backup.

glyphs.label: 真
glyphs.visual_contract: A verification eye under a seal mark; should read as truth/grounding, not an ordinary 真.

glyphs.label: 返
glyphs.meaning: 返回、回到前一状态或位置。
glyphs.visual_contract: A path stroke folding back into itself; should read as return/rollback.

glyphs.label: 身
glyphs.visual_contract: A vertical body spine with two bound shoulders; should read as embodied carrier.

glyphs.label: 行
glyphs.visual_contract: A crossroad with paired stepping strokes; should read as movement/path execution.

glyphs.label: 疾
glyphs.visual_contract: A forward arrow with trailing cut marks; should read as acceleration.

glyphs.label: 水
glyphs.visual_contract: A central water channel with two side drops; should read as controlled flow.

glyphs.label: 书
glyphs.visual_contract: An open page spine with index teeth; should read as book/dictionary.

glyphs.label: 光
glyphs.visual_contract: A contained light core with short witness rays; should read as illumination/visibility.

glyphs.label: 归
glyphs.meaning: 归位、回家、回到所属坐标。
glyphs.visual_contract: A threshold receiving an inward arrow; should read as homecoming/return-to-place.

glyphs.label: 桥
glyphs.meaning: 桥接、跨界连接、接口稳定。
glyphs.visual_contract: An arch bridge over a gap with two anchor piers; should read as bridge/interface.

glyphs.label: 静
glyphs.visual_contract: A sealed signal field with muted bars; should read as silence/suppression.

glyphs.label: 删
glyphs.meaning: 删除、抹除、让文本和名字空白化。
glyphs.visual_contract: A page block cut by a hard deletion slash; should read as erasure.

glyphs.label: 界
glyphs.visual_contract: A divided field frame with a central crossing; should read as domain boundary.

glyphs.label: 修
glyphs.visual_contract: A patch square held by a tool stroke; should read as repair/maintenance.

glyphs.label: 护
glyphs.visual_contract: A shielded door with a hand-like guard stroke; should read as protection.

glyphs.label: 国
glyphs.meaning: 疆域、公共系统、国书作用域。
glyphs.visual_contract: A civic enclosure with a central statebook node; should read as governed domain.

glyphs.label: 律
glyphs.visual_contract: A rule column with measured bars; should read as legal procedure.

glyphs.label: 墨
glyphs.meaning: 墨力、书写介质、文字能量。
glyphs.visual_contract: A heavy ink drop settling into a ground seal; should read as ink-energy.
